decisions.reason: The dismantling joint sits close to the firm's established fittings range and costs little to keep listed, so after just one year its value is still uncertain and the option is worth holding open.

The ceiling or floor bracket has its own product page, which signals commitment; it fits existing fabrication capabilities at low carrying cost, and one year gives too little evidence to justify abandoning it.
The pipe support bracket builds on established steel fabrication and is prominently presented, so keeping it is cheap while its prospects are still resolving.
